benchmarks.memory_metric: Peak process working set on Windows; peak RSS on Unix. Includes interpreter/modules and group/organism counters; input records are streamed.
benchmarks.algorithm: Single TSV pass; grouped counters, no full table in memory.
benchmarks.memory_growth: Proportional to distinct design groups plus organism names; run rows are not retained.
benchmarks.projection_caveat: Extrapolation from observed rows, not a measured10million run; hardware, IO, group cardinality and API acquisition can change scaling.

scope: Ordered input prefixes in separate processes; computational performance, not probability-sampled biological designs.
caveat: Parse time excludes network acquisition and result JSON writing. Fresh-process peak RSS includes module startup. Full input measurement is reused from the primary aggregate run; full run need not represent the entire archive.
